## What We Do
Generate professional emails with AI — cold outreach, follow-ups, replies, sales, job applications, meeting requests. Free, no sign-up, instant results.

## Key Differentiators
- 100% free vs Rytr (10K chars/mo) and Jasper ($49/seat)
- No sign-up required
- Privacy-first: processed through Cloudflare, never stored
- "When NOT to use" section for honest limitations

## FAQ
Q: Free? A: Yes, 100% free, no signup, no limits.
Q: Privacy? A: Emails processed through Cloudflare, never stored or logged.
Q: When NOT to use? A: Legal documents, medical advice, emergency messages.
